command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_08/nodes'; foreach(`$n in `$nodes){ `$u8='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_08/nodes/'+`$n.node_id+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$r8=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u8; `$u9='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_09/nodes/'+`$n.node_id+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$r9=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u9; if(`$r8.output -like 'Error:*'){ `$u8='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_08/nodes/'+`$n.node_id+'/command?cmd=show%20running-config'; `$r8=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u8 }; if(`$r9.output -like 'Error:*'){ `$u9='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_09/nodes/'+`$n.node_id+'/command?cmd=show%20running-config'; `$r9=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u9 }; if(`$r8.output -notlike 'Error:*' -and `$r9.output -notlike 'Error:*'){ `$o8=`$r8.output -split '\r?\n' | ForEach-Object { `$_.Trim() } | Where-Object { `$_ -and `$_ -notmatch '(?i)^Last configuration|^Current configuration|^!Time:|^snmp.*engineid|^username admin password|^crypto pki' }; `$o9=`$r9.output -split '\r?\n' | ForEach-Object { `$_.Trim() } | Where-Object { `$_ -and `$_ -notmatch '(?i)^Last configuration|^Current configuration|^!Time:|^snmp.*engineid|^username admin password|^crypto pki' }; `$d=Compare-Object -ReferenceObject `$o8 -DifferenceObject `$o9 | Where-Object { `$_.InputObject -match '(?i)interface|ip |stp|vrrp|ospf|bgp|isis|mpls|lsp|static|route|vlan|peer|shutdown|mtu|bandwidth|traffic|qos|arp|mac-address|hrp|nat|security|prefix|srv6|vxlan|bpdu|cost|policy|track' }; if(`$d){ '### '+`$n.name+' (09 vs 08)'; `$d | ForEach-Object { `$_.SideIndicator+' '+`$_.InputObject } } } }"
